description: Renames a single wireframe element (sets WireframeElement.Name). Undoable - the old name is supplied explicitly so Undo() can restore it; a null or whitespace new name clears the name. Pushed by the properties panel's Name field.

members.name: RenameElementCommand
members.type: RenameElementCommand(WireframeDocument doc, string elementId, string? oldName, string? newName)
members.description: Creates the command; oldName may be null when the element was unnamed.

members.name: Name
members.description: Human-readable label shown in undo/redo tooltips.

members.name: Execute
members.description: Applies the change to the document.

members.name: Undo
members.description: Restores the name captured before Execute() ran.
